name: dsh-office-audit
description: Financial-model and workbook auditor for DeepSeek Harness: one office_audit tool that recalculates formulas with the bundled LibreOffice Kit and then runs static checks over the recalculated values — formula errors, broken references, formula-consistency, hardcoded constants, number-format and unit mismatches, balance-sheet balance, retained-earnings roll-forward, cash tie-out, cash-flow subtotals, ratio-table conventions and data-cleaning issues. Read-only; the source workbook is never modified.
